sections.Profile:
Hayburners II , released by Williams in 1968, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a horse-racing theme, designed by Steve Kordek and Norm Clark, with artwork by Christian Marche. It is notable for being the first machine to introduce 3-inch "king-size" flippers, which later became the industry standard.
